verses.text: 'As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword; take and use it [as] a barber's razor on your head and beard. Then take scales for weighing and divide the hair.
verses.textZh: 人子啊，你要拿一把快刀，當作剃頭刀，用這刀剃你的頭髮和你的鬍鬚，用天平將鬚髮平分。

verses.text: 'One third you shall burn in the fire at the center of the city, when the days of the siege are completed. Then you shall take one third and strike [it] with the sword all around the city, and one third you shall scatter to the wind; and I will unsheathe a sword behind them.
verses.textZh: 圍困城的日子滿了，你要將三分之一在城中用火焚燒，將三分之一在城的四圍用刀砍碎，將三分之一任風吹散；我也要拔刀追趕。

verses.text: 'Take also a few in number from them and bind them in the edges of your [robes].
verses.textZh: 你要從其中取幾根包在衣襟裡，

verses.text: 'Take again some of them and throw them into the fire and burn them in the fire; from it a fire will spread to all the house of Israel.
verses.textZh: 再從這幾根中取些扔在火中焚燒，從裡面必有火出來燒入以色列全家。

verses.text: 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'This is Jerusalem; I have set her at the center of the nations, with lands around her.
verses.textZh: 主耶和華如此說：這就是耶路撒冷。我曾將他安置在列邦之中；列國都在他的四圍。

verses.text: 'But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations and against My statutes more than the lands which surround her; for they have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.'
verses.textZh: 他行惡，違背我的典章，過於列國；干犯我的律例，過於四圍的列邦，因為他棄掉我的典章。至於我的律例，他並沒有遵行。

verses.text: 'Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD, 'Because you have more turmoil than the nations which surround you [and] have not walked in My statutes, nor observed My ordinances, nor observed the ordinances of the nations which surround you,'
verses.textZh: 所以主耶和華如此說：因為你們紛爭過於四圍的列國，也不遵行我的律例，不謹守我的典章，並以遵從四圍列國的惡規尚不滿意，

verses.text: therefore, thus says the Lord GOD, 'Behold, I, even I, am against you, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
verses.textZh: 所以主耶和華如此說：看哪，我與你反對，必在列國的眼前，在你中間，施行審判；

verses.text: 'And because of all your abominations, I will do among you what I have not done, and the like of which I will never do again.
verses.textZh: 並且因你一切可憎的事，我要在你中間行我所未曾行的，以後我也不再照著行。

verses.text: 'Therefore, fathers will eat [their] sons among you, and sons will eat their fathers; for I will execute judgments on you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.
verses.textZh: 在你中間父親要吃兒子，兒子要吃父親。我必向你施行審判，我必將你所剩下的分散四方（方：原文是風）。

verses.text: 'So as I live,' declares the Lord GOD, 'surely, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and with all your abominations, therefore I will also withdraw, and My eye will have no pity and I will not spare.
verses.textZh: 主耶和華說：我指著我的永生起誓，因你用一切可憎的物、可厭的事玷污了我的聖所，故此，我定要使你人數減少，我眼必不顧惜你，也不可憐你。

verses.text: 'One third of you will die by plague or be consumed by famine among you, one third will fall by the sword around you, and one third I will scatter to every wind, and I will unsheathe a sword behind them.
verses.textZh: 你的民三分之一必遭瘟疫而死，在你中間必因饑荒消滅；三分之一必在你四圍倒在刀下；我必將三分之一分散四方（方：原文是風），並要拔刀追趕他們。

verses.text: 'Thus My anger will be spent and I will satisfy My wrath on them, and I will be appeased; then they will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in My zeal when I have spent My wrath upon them.
verses.textZh: 我要這樣成就怒中所定的；我向他們發的忿怒止息了，自己就得著安慰。我在他們身上成就怒中所定的那時，他們就知道我─耶和華所說的是出於熱心；

verses.text: 'Moreover, I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations which surround you, in the sight of all who pass by.
verses.textZh: 並且我必使你在四圍的列國中，在經過的眾人眼前，成了荒涼和羞辱。

verses.text: 'So it will be a reproach, a reviling, a warning and an object of horror to the nations who surround you when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath and raging rebukes. I, the LORD, have spoken.
verses.textZh: 這樣，我必以怒氣和忿怒，並烈怒的責備，向你施行審判。那時，你就在四圍的列國中成為羞辱、譏刺、警戒、驚駭。這是我─耶和華說的。

verses.text: 'When I send against them the deadly arrows of famine which were for the destruction of those whom I will send to destroy you, then I will also intensify the famine upon you and break the staff of bread.
verses.textZh: 那時，我要將滅人、使人饑荒的惡箭，就是射去滅人的，射在你們身上，並要加增你們的饑荒，斷絕你們所倚靠的糧食；

verses.text: 'Moreover, I will send on you famine and wild beasts, and they will bereave you of children; plague and bloodshed also will pass through you, and I will bring the sword on you. I, the LORD, have spoken.''
verses.textZh: 又要使饑荒和惡獸到你那裡，叫你喪子，瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那裡；我也要使刀劍臨到你。這是我─耶和華說的。
